sample_metadata.expected_output_shape: A single ISO 8601 date string in the form YYYY-MM-DD, with no surrounding prose.
sample_metadata.input: A team schedules a follow-up meeting for exactly 30 days after Friday, March 6, 2026. What is the calendar date of the follow-up meeting in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)?
sample_metadata.quality_rubric_notes: Correct answer is exactly '2026-04-05' (March has 31 days; 25 days remain in March after the 6th; 30 - 25 = 5 days into April, giving April 5). The literal token '2026-04-05' must appear; equivalent forms like 'April 5, 2026' are partial credit because they do not match the requested ISO shape.
